questions: Does 'sort P in order' mean ascending order (1,2,...,N) or could it also be descending order (N,N-1,...,1)?
Is the cost of swapping P_i and P_{i+1} always exactly i, regardless of the values being swapped?
Can we perform multiple operations simultaneously or only one at a time?
Are we allowed to choose the same i multiple times in a sequence?
Does the cost accumulate per swap, or is there any discount for consecutive swaps?
Should the output be the minimum total cost over all possible sequences of swaps that result in a sorted permutation?
Is the permutation guaranteed to be sortable using only adjacent swaps (i.e., is it always possible)?
If multiple swap sequences achieve the same minimum cost, does it matter which one we consider?
